title: Exact derived composition in ordinary finite representative coordinates
statement: For composable h:Z→X and f:X→Y, the intrinsic derived pullback compositor, followed by h* of the finite ordinary computation map for f and the computation map for h at the ordinary f-pullback of P, equals the computation map for h≫f followed by Q of the specified ordinary termwise compositor. This holds for every unbounded complex P, without flatness or invertibility assumptions. All computation maps and compositors are the concrete coordinate constructions of def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-representative-data.

source.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product; ordinary tensor formula in sites-modules.tex, lemma-tensor-product-pullback (03EL); unit and adjunction composition in sites.tex (00YV).

proof.text: Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso respects composition of natural isomorphisms and their left and right whiskerings. Apply these identities to the definition of the conjugated ordinary module compositor. Its localized compositor is the intrinsic derived compositor conjugated by the three realized comparisons.

For the ordinary exact functors, mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_hom_app_factors and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac identify the localized compositor followed by the two ordinary computation maps with the direct computation map followed by Q of the termwise compositor. Naturality moves the realization maps across these computation maps; cancel their inverse pairs to obtain the claimed equation. The generic transport_fac lemma carries out these cancellations.

lean.statement:
theorem compositor_fac {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Z ⟶ X) (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) ℤ) :
    (sfIntrinsicDerivedPullbackComp (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) h f).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        (finiteDerivedPullback l E n h).map ((factors l E f n).hom.app P) ≫
        (factors l E h n).hom.app ((pull l E f n).obj P) =
      (factors l E (h ≫ f) n).hom.app P ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((complexComp l E f h n).hom.app P)
